_comment: pi-status config. Precedence (later overrides earlier): global ~/.pi/agent/pi-status.json < extension ./config.json (this dir) < project <cwd>/.pi/pi-status.json (trusted). Partial configs merge over the built-in defaults. Zero config = defaults below. TWO surfaces: (1) tmux window tab — replaces the tokyo-night theme terminal icon on pi's tmux window via a WINDOW-LEVEL window-status-format patch (other windows keep the global theme format). Every Pi process writes @pi_status_instance_<pid> with its PID, current session ID, and idle|gen|done state, so multiple Pi processes are tracked independently even when several Neovim terminals share one tmux pane. @pi_t is the aggregate marker: if all processes are idle it is one prefix; otherwise idle is implicit and each non-zero active state is rendered as its icon plus a superscript count, for example busy=2 and done=2 becomes 'busy ²done ²'. Zero counts are omitted. Dead-PID records are pruned during reconciliation. (2) pi-statusline — pushes this pi's own state via ctx.ui.setStatus(statusKey, 'idle'|'gen'|'done'). Focus is supplied by the standalone pi-focus extension over the 'pi-focus:change' event bus channel. pi-status never enables or consumes DEC 1004. When a turn settles while unfocused it enters done; the next focus-in event reverts it to idle/prefix. Inside tmux, pi-focus requires `set -g focus-events on` or pane switches won't report. activeGlyph/inactiveGlyph are the theme's baked-in terminal-icon glyphs to replace (defaults match tokyo-night: \ue795 active, \uf489 inactive). statusKey is the ext-status key pushed to pi-statusline. No-op outside TUI mode; tmux surface additionally no-op outside tmux. Use /pi-status reload after edits.
